notes.title: Patch Note 1.03 Asterix & Obelix Slap Them All! 2 – Holidays Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]New enemy added – Medium Thug
[*]Global improvements on enemies’ behaviour
[*]New weather effects: rain and snow
[*]Improved banner for Ultimates
[*]New "anti-lock" system to help heroes escape from blow chains
[*]Bugfix and minor improvements
[list]
[*]Fix of an issue that made enemies remain on the screen even after being defeated
[*]Fix an issue that brings an enemy out of bounds, not permitting to reach further gameplay
[/list][/list]
